cat > /tmp/recon/analyze.py <<'EOF'
import json, collections
from datetime import datetime, timezone
pages = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/pages.json")); custs = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/customers.json"))
items = [o for p in sorted(pages, key=int) for o in pages[p]["items"]]
print("listings", len(items), "pages", len(pages))
seen = {}; dups = 0; conflicts = 0
for o in items:
    if o["id"] in seen:
        dups += 1
        if seen[o["id"]] != o: conflicts += 1; print("CONFLICT", seen[o["id"]], o)
    else: seen[o["id"]] = o
print("unique", len(seen), "dups", dups, "conflicting dups", conflicts)
print("statuses", collections.Counter(repr(o["status"]) for o in seen.values()))
print("keys", collections.Counter(tuple(sorted(o)) for o in seen.values()))
print("amount types", collections.Counter(type(o["amount_cents"]).__name__ for o in seen.values()), "neg", sum(1 for o in seen.values() if isinstance(o["amount_cents"],(int,float)) and o["amount_cents"]<0))
fmts = collections.Counter()
for o in seen.values():
    s = o["placed_at"]; fmts[(len(s), s[19:])] += 1 if True else 0
print("ts suffix kinds", collections.Counter(o["placed_at"][19:][:1] + str(len(o["placed_at"])) for o in seen.values()))
print("missing customers", [c for c, v in custs.items() if v is None])
print("cust keys", collections.Counter(tuple(sorted(v)) for v in custs.values() if v))
print("regions", collections.Counter(repr(v["region"]) for v in custs.values() if v))
print("discounts", collections.Counter(repr(v["discount_pct"]) for v in custs.values() if v))
print("id mismatch", [c for c,v in custs.items() if v and v["id"]!=c])
EOF
python3 -I /tmp/recon/analyze.py

input.command:
cat > /tmp/recon/compute.py <<'EOF'
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
pages = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/pages.json")); custs = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/customers.json"))
items = [o for p in sorted(pages, key=int) for o in pages[p]["items"]]
seen = {}; dups = 0
for o in items:
    if o["id"] in seen: dups += 1
    else: seen[o["id"]] = o
ids = sorted(seen); print("id range", ids[0], ids[-1], "expected count", int(ids[-1][4:]) == len(ids))
lo = datetime(2025,3,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc); hi = datetime(2025,6,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
by = {"north":0,"south":0,"east":0,"west":0}; n = 0; edge = 0
for o in seen.values():
    if o["status"] != "shipped": continue
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(o["placed_at"].replace("Z","+00:00")); assert t.tzinfo
    tu = t.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    if (lo <= tu < hi) != (lo.date() <= t.date() <= datetime(2025,5,31).date()): edge += 1
    if not (lo <= tu < hi): continue
    c = custs[o["customer_id"]]; d = c["discount_pct"]
    by[c["region"]] += (o["amount_cents"] * (100 - d) + 50) // 100; n += 1
res = {"total_cents": sum(by.values()), "order_count": n, "duplicates_skipped": dups, "by_region": by}
print(res, "local-vs-UTC boundary cases:", edge)
json.dump(res, open("/workspace/result.json","w"), indent=2)
EOF
python3 -I /tmp/recon/compute.py; cat /workspace/result.json

import json
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
a=json.load(open("/tmp/recon/pages1.json")); b=json.load(open("/tmp/recon/pages.json"))
ca=json.load(open("/tmp/recon/customers1.json")); cb=json.load(open("/tmp/recon/customers.json"))
ua={o["id"]:o for p in a.values() for o in p["items"]}; ub={o["id"]:o for p in b.values() for o in p["items"]}
print("orders identical across fetches:", ua==ub, "customers identical:", ca==cb)
print("dup listings 2nd fetch:", sum(len(p["items"]) for p in b.values())-len(ub))
r=json.load(open("/workspace/result.json"))
print("keys ok", list(r)==["total_cents","order_count","duplicates_skipped","by_region"], sorted(r["by_region"])==sorted(["north","south","east","west"]), "sum ok", sum(r["by_region"].values())==r["total_cents"])
# Decimal cross-check and count of exact .5 cases
from datetime import datetime, timezone
tot=0; half=0
for o in ua.values():
    if o["status"]!="shipped": continue
    t=datetime.fromisoformat(o["placed_at"].replace("Z","+00:00")).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    if not (datetime(2025,3,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)<=t<datetime(2025,6,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)): continue
    x=Decimal(o["amount_cents"])*(100-ca[o["customer_id"]]["discount_pct"])/100
    if x%1==Decimal("0.5"): half+=1
    tot+=int(x.quantize(Decimal(1),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print("decimal total", tot, "exact half-cent cases", half)
EOF
